  "memo":"R03 holds because the card issuing country differs from the IP country and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The required id_check failed, so §5.3(b) overrides the usual hold under §6.6(b) and requires decline without Linkage. Legitimate cross-border card use remains a competing explanation, but the failed check decides the action. The order is unshipped: decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. Escalation is prohibited without Linkage. No further check is needed."
